text:
Situation: Soybean oil 20 g/100 mL inventory varies across sites. Corvale East holds 58 units with 17.2 days on hand. Corvale General holds 48 units with 11.1 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 9 units with 10.2 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include soybean oil as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate at Corvale East but limited at Corvale General and Corvale Lakeside. No national shortage is declared.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 20 units from Corvale East to Corvale Lakeside; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Transfer 15 units from Corvale East to Corvale General; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
3. Place supplemental orders for all three sites through the primary wholesaler; requires Buyer approval.
4. Monitor daily usage and days-on-hand at each site; requires Inventory Manager approval.

Not recommended: No allocation restrictions or conservation protocols at this time.
